checks.evidence: The response drafts one public comment on #42 that begins "Triaged by Intake worker. Implementation has not started", names the missing native sample needed for acceptance, and states that the private receipt is "not a visible acknowledgement."
It says "Don't claim active implementation on #42" and that the issue "stays 'triaged,' not 'assigned'"; it adds no new permission gate.

It relies on the fresh read over the "stale intake snapshot", says "I will not start a competing writer", keeps Fix worker and PR #84 as owner, and commits to "track PR #84 through review/merge/release."
The issue update says "Deferring to existing owner; no competing work will be started", and the response marks the local ready task as superseded, with no reassignment.

It re-reads #44 first, records the comment ID it finds without posting a duplicate, posts an update "only if something substantive changed", and keeps the event "pending (do not mark acknowledged)" if the comment is not found.
It retries only after rereading, saves the comment ID to T17 privately, and puts neither T17 nor the private path in any public comment.

After the helper failure it uses the established CLI under the same authorized role. For the API refusal it reports "the acknowledgement is unsent", names the boundary and that a "repo admin must grant" access, and keeps the ack pending while continuing other safe work. For the operator's no-comment scope it reports the comment is "drafted but unsent per instruction."
It says "I do not switch accounts, escalate, or grant comment rights" and "a private/local note does not count as acknowledgement."

It filters the drain's own comments "by specific comment id/revision, not 'any activity by this account'", detects the reporter's reproducer as a distinct eligible event, and keeps quiet-queue polling at "zero model wakeups."

The watcher "durably records this event ... before waking the drain". On authentication failure it does "not advance the seen-marker", reports through deterministic health/status output, and retries "idempotently" without model turns.
It edits the existing intake comment to say "Merged, release pending. PR #85 merged...", gives the release/install and consumer next steps, and says "Issue remains open."
It says "merged code alone doesn't satisfy the original promise" and "No closure ... until release/install evidence is recorded."
It says "I'd load draining-issues" because it covers intake, claiming and continuing to watch when the queue is quiet.
It proposes no idle scheduled model prompt or maintenance skill; the only other skill it names is the meta-skill using-superpowers, which it uses to confirm draining-issues.
